contexts.text: Jehovah killed all the first-born in the land of Egypt () = that all who were in faith separated from charity were damned.

There was given to them the Power of killing over the fourth part of the earth () = the destruction of all the good of the Church. As by death is meant the extinction of man's spiritual life, and as by Hell is meant damnation, it follows that by to kill is here meant to destroy the life of man's soul.
On the right side of the lake... are those who seek to kill each other with cruel instruments... SE 1396, General article.
If he could have killed the universal human race for the mere glory of his name, he would have had the highest pleasure from it.
They are such as have killed men in cold blood...

There was given to them the Power of killing over the fourth part of the earth = the deprivation of all good and thence of all truth from the Word, and thence in their doctrine of the Church from the Word... To kill, or to kill, = to deprive of good and truth.
Their fellow-servants and their brethren who should be killed as they were () = evils; for to kill them = evil.
